newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds look to retake 114-15 high.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds look to retake 114-15 high.

text.p: September T-bond futures will aim to retake the recent 114-15 high on Monday but will find the going tough beyond there.

"It seems to be building a small uptrend but I don't think there's a huge amount of momentum in it and I think it's going to be a quietish day as we try and establish ourselves at the top of the range we have at the moment," said Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking.
T-bonds were quoted at 114-01 in automated trade, down 3/32 from Chicago's pit settlement on Friday. Ostwald said initial resistance came in at congestion on Friday at 114-06/08.

"If we break through there, then we go for the high on Friday at 114-15, then there's a bit of congestion above that 114-22,25," Ostwald said. Congestion there comes from continuation chart highs in early December.
Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, was positive on the contract longer term.

"It's hovering up against the top of this bull channel," he told Reuters Financial Television. "We may not get a push up to 115/116 immediately, but we're still of the opinion that there's underlying support and that pullbacks offer an opportunity to buy this market."
Charts show a bull channel in place since April.
Ostwald said T-bonds would find support this session around 113-20,23, from lows and closes last week. "Below that, at 113-12, Tuesday's low," he said.
"I'd be very surprised if it went outside those ranges today," he said.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were quoted at 94.070, unchanged in automated trade.
